from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
forms = {
 'A_t_sin': lambda p: p[0]*np.sqrt(P)+p[1]*P*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[3])+p[4]*t*np.sin(p[5]*t+p[6]),
 'C_tpow_sin': lambda p: p[0]*np.sqrt(P)+p[1]*P*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[3])+p[4]*np.abs(t)**p[7]*np.sin(p[5]*t+p[6]),
 'D_Pt_sin': lambda p: p[0]*np.sqrt(P)+p[1]*P*t*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[3])+p[4]*np.sin(p[5]*t+p[6]),
 'E_P_cos_t': lambda p: p[0]*np.sqrt(P)+p[1]*P*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[3])+p[4]*t*np.cos(p[5]*t+p[6]),
}
out=[]
for name,fn in forms.items():
    best=None
    rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
    for k in range(120):
        p0=np.r_[rng.normal(0,2,2),rng.uniform(0.2,1,1),rng.normal(0,2,1),rng.normal(0,2,1),rng.uniform(0.1,0.6,1),rng.normal(0,2,1),rng.uniform(-1,2,1)]
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: fn(p)-y, p0)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(r.x)) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
        except Exception: pass
    if best is not None:
        out.append(f"{name} NMSE {best.cost*2/np.sum((y-y.mean())**2):.3e} {np.round(best.x,4).tolist()}")
print("\n".join(out))
